name: dithering
summary: Full-bleed hero running Paper Shaders' dithering on WebGL2: a turning sphere resolved into a 4x4 ordered-dither field of cyan dots on black, off-centre so the copy sits beside it, over a matched CSS halftone.

colors.description: Back colour then front colour. Omit to read --fx-c1 and --fx-c2 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one pair. Upstream default preset.

speed.description: Rate the sphere turns. 0 renders a single static frame. Forced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

shape.description: What gets dithered: simplex, warp, dots, wave, ripple, swirl or sphere.

type.description: Dither matrix: random, 2x2, 4x4 or 8x8. Larger matrices give smoother gradients and a finer pattern.

size.description: Dot size in pixels. This is a device-pixel size, so it does not scale with the section.

deviations.what: u_offsetX is -0.34; every upstream dithering preset uses 0.
deviations.why: The sphere sits dead centre at offset 0, right under the headline. -0.34 moves it left (measured: negative moves left) so the copy column has the right half of the section to itself. Nothing else about the shape changes.
